question: Will The Odyssey gross more than Spider-Man: Brand New Day at the domestic box office this weekend (Sept 18–20)?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to actuals via The Numbers or Box Office Mojo
research:
I couldn't find any reported figures for Sept 18-20. Last weekend Spider-Man: Brand New Day beat The Odyssey by about $0.8M (roughly 10%). That gap has been shrinking because The Odyssey is losing audience more slowly. Several sites (The Numbers, Box Office Mojo, Rotten Tomatoes, Boxoffice Pro) blocked direct page loads, so the figures below come from search-result summaries. I left out every search result dated after 2026-09-18.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on The Numbers or Box Office Mojo weekend actuals for Sept 18-20. As of 2026-09-18 no figures for that weekend could have existed yet. [The Numbers chart](https://www.the-numbers.com/box-office-chart/weekend/2026/09/11)
- 2026-09-13/14: The Numbers' weekend chart for Sept 11-13 (via search summary):
  - Practical Magic 2: $30.0M, 4,146 theaters
  - Spider-Man: Brand New Day: **$8,410,743**, 3,303 theaters, $935.18M total
  - The Odyssey: **$7,592,750**, 1,983 theaters, $600.70M total
  - [The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com/box-office-chart/weekend/2026/09/11)
- Box Office Mojo's daily chart for Sept 11 shows slightly different running totals for Spider-Man ($928.8M on that date). [BOM](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/date/2026-09-11/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Spider-Man led last weekend by about $0.82M.
- The Odyssey earns more per theater: about $3,830 per theater against about $2,550 for Spider-Man, in roughly 1,300 fewer theaters. I could not find either film's theater count for this weekend.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-15/16: Spider-Man passed The Force Awakens ($936.66M) on Tuesday to become the top domestic grosser of all time, at $936.77M. With that milestone done, Sony has less reason to keep pushing the film. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/09/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-record-tom-rothman-1237105672/), [Collider](https://collider.com/spider-man-brand-new-day-overtakes-force-awakens-domestic-box-office-record/)
- 2026-09-13: Practical Magic 2 opened at No. 1 with $30M and ended Spider-Man's six-weekend run at the top.
  - Spider-Man made $8.4M, down 54%.
  - The Odyssey came third with about $7.0-7.4M on Sunday estimates (actuals were $7.59M), in its ninth weekend.
  - [AP via ABC](https://abcnews.com/Entertainment/wireStory/practical-magic-2-conjures-1-box-office-debut-136406662), [AV Club](https://www.avclub.com/weekend-box-office-practical-magic-2)
- 2026-09-07: Over Labor Day (four days), Spider-Man made $23.5M and The Odyssey about $17.3M. The Odyssey's Friday-Sunday was about $13M. [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/spiderman-brand-new-day-box-office-sixth-weekend-1236852435/), [MyNewsLA](https://mynewsla.com/hollywood/2026/09/07/spider-man-brand-new-day-the-odyssey-lead-weekend-box-office-4/)
- Labor Day global weekend: The Odyssey (about $46M) beat Spider-Man worldwide. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/09/box-office-global-odyssey-beats-spider-man-brand-new-day-1237069465/)
- New wide release this weekend: Sony's Resident Evil, tracking at $40-50M (Boxoffice Pro). It is R-rated horror, so it may compete more with Spider-Man for screens than with The Odyssey. [Boxoffice Pro](https://www.boxofficepro.com/weekend-preview-resident-evil-set-to-swarm-cinemas-with-a-franchise-record/)

## 4. Base rates and trends
- Gap between the two films, Friday-Sunday:
  - Labor Day: Spider-Man about $18.3M (my estimate, back-calculated from its 54% drop) vs The Odyssey $13M, a gap of about $5.3M.
  - Sept 11-13: $8.41M vs $7.59M, a gap of $0.82M.
- Week-over-week drops on Sept 11-13: Spider-Man -54%, The Odyssey about -42%. Part of that comes from comparing against an inflated holiday weekend.
- If both films repeat those drops, Spider-Man would make about $3.9M and The Odyssey about $4.4M. That flips the order, so this is close.
  - If both drop a similar 35-45% in a normal post-holiday week, Spider-Man stays narrowly ahead.
  - The Odyssey needs to drop about 10 percentage points less than Spider-Man to come out on top.
- The Odyssey's late run has held up well (Nolan film, premium-format share). Spider-Man has been losing more each week, partly because of new family-friendly and genre competition.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this matchup.
- Boxoffice Pro's preview only forecasts the top 3, and I could not see whether its figures included these two films.
- BoxOfficeReport posted predictions for this weekend on 2026-09-17, but the page would not load and I could not get the figures. [BoxOfficeReport](http://www.boxofficereport.com/predictions/predictions20260917.html)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Weekday dailies for Sept 14-17 (Box Office Mojo / The Numbers) would show the latest relative pace. I could not get them.
- Studio Sunday estimates come out Sept 20, actuals on Sept 21.
- Theater counts this weekend matter. Resident Evil is taking about 3,684 screens, including premium formats, and losing IMAX or PLF screens would hurt The Odyssey more.
- If Sony pulls back marketing after the record, Spider-Man could drop faster.

Sources: [The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com/box-office-chart/weekend/2026/09/11), [BOM Sep 11](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/date/2026-09-11/), [AP/ABC](https://abcnews.com/Entertainment/wireStory/practical-magic-2-conjures-1-box-office-debut-136406662), [AV Club](https://www.avclub.com/weekend-box-office-practical-magic-2), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/spiderman-brand-new-day-box-office-sixth-weekend-1236852435/), [MyNewsLA](https://mynewsla.com/hollywood/2026/09/07/spider-man-brand-new-day-the-odyssey-lead-weekend-box-office-4/), [Deadline record](https://deadline.com/2026/09/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-record-tom-rothman-1237105672/), [Collider](https://collider.com/spider-man-brand-new-day-overtakes-force-awakens-domestic-box-office-record/), [Deadline global](https://deadline.com/2026/09/box-office-global-odyssey-beats-spider-man-brand-new-day-1237069465/), [Boxoffice Pro](https://www.boxofficepro.com/weekend-preview-resident-evil-set-to-swarm-cinemas-with-a-franchise-record/), [BoxOfficeReport](http://www.boxofficereport.com/predictions/predictions20260917.html)
